name: laikait/laika-mailman
description: Mail package for the Laika PHP MVC Framework — send via PHPMailer (SMTP/sendmail/mail/qmail), read via built-in IMAP and POP3 clients.

suggest.league/oauth2-client: Required only if you use PHPMailer's bundled OAuth class for XOAUTH2 — implementing OAuthTokenProvider yourself needs nothing
